title: Cosmic Dreamer on Ledge
description: A person with blue hair and galaxy-patterned skin reclines on a concrete ledge against a vibrant blue and purple sky. They wear an oversized cosmic robe, surrounded by floating tarot cards, geometric shapes, paint cans dripping colorful liquid, and a melting popsicle.
prompt: A androgynous figure with short blue hair and iridescent galaxy-patterned skin lounges on a concrete ledge, wearing an oversized flowing robe covered in stars and nebulae. One hand holds a glowing geometric shape while the other rests near a melting popsicle. Colorful tarot cards with intricate designs float through the air around them, along with geometric crystals and dripping paint cans. The background is a dreamy gradient sky of bright blue and purple with soft clouds, in a vibrant surreal style.
